name: airlock
description: Nothing reaches production without passing through the airlock.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @airlock/contract && npm run build --workspace @airlock/mcp && npm run build --workspace @airlock/console
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @airlock/contract && npm run build --workspace @airlock/mcp && node --test packages/contract/test/*.test.mjs packages/mcp/test/*.test.mjs && node scripts/check-fixtures.mjs && node scripts/check-agents.mjs
scripts.gen: npm run build --workspace @airlock/contract && npm run gen:schema && npm run gen:capabilities && npm run gen:policy && npm run gen:examples && npm run check:fixtures
